passages.text: This is the burden against Nineveh, the book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite: The LORD is a jealous and avenging God; the LORD is avenging and full of wrath. The LORD takes vengeance on His foes and reserves wrath for His enemies.
passages.sermon:
Nahum was a prophet from Elkosh.
He wrote a vision from God.
This vision is about Nineveh.
The LORD is God.
The LORD is jealous.
The LORD is an avenger.
The LORD is full of wrath.
The LORD takes vengeance on His foes.
The LORD stores up wrath for His enemies.
passages.original: מַשָּׂ֖א נִֽינְוֵ֑ה סֵ֧פֶר חֲז֛וֹן נַח֖וּם הָאֶלְקֹשִֽׁי׃ אֵ֣ל קַנּ֤וֹא וְנֹקֵם֙ יְהוָ֔ה נֹקֵ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה וּבַ֣עַל חֵמָ֑ה נֹקֵ֤ם יְהוָה֙ לְצָרָ֔יו וְנוֹטֵ֥ר ה֖וּא לְאֹיְבָֽיו׃

passages.text: The LORD is slow to anger and great in power; the LORD will by no means leave the guilty unpunished. His path is in the whirlwind and storm, and clouds are the dust beneath His feet.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is slow to anger.
The LORD has great power.
The LORD does not leave the guilty unpunished.
The LORD moves in the whirlwind and the storm.
Clouds are like dust under His feet.
passages.original: יְהֹוָ֗ה אֶ֤רֶךְ אַפַּ֙יִם֙ וּגְדוֹל כֹּ֔חַ וְנַקֵּ֖ה לֹ֣א יְנַקֶּ֑ה יְהוָ֗ה בְּסוּפָ֤ה וּבִשְׂעָרָה֙ דַּרְכּ֔וֹ וְעָנָ֖ן אֲבַ֥ק רַגְלָֽיו׃

passages.text: He rebukes the sea and dries it up; He makes all the rivers run dry. Bashan and Carmel wither, and the flower of Lebanon wilts.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the subject.
The LORD has great power.
The LORD rebukes the sea.
The sea dries up.
The LORD makes all the rivers run dry.
Bashan withers.
Carmel withers.
The flower of Lebanon wilts.
passages.original: גּוֹעֵ֤ר בַּיָּם֙ וַֽיַּבְּשֵׁ֔הוּ וְכָל־ הַנְּהָר֖וֹת הֶֽחֱרִ֑יב אֻמְלַ֤ל בָּשָׁן֙ וְכַרְמֶ֔ל וּפֶ֥רַח לְבָנ֖וֹן אֻמְלָֽל׃

passages.text: The mountains quake before Him, and the hills melt away; the earth trembles at His presence— the world and all its dwellers.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is powerful and holy.
Mountains shake when the LORD appears.
Hills melt away before Him.
The earth trembles in His presence.
The whole world feels His power.
Everyone who lives on earth is affected by Him.
passages.original: הָרִים֙ רָעֲשׁ֣וּ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ וְהַגְּבָע֖וֹת הִתְמֹגָ֑גוּ וַתִּשָּׂ֤א הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ מִפָּנָ֔יו וְתֵבֵ֖ל וְכָל־ יֹ֥שְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃

passages.text: Who can withstand His indignation? Who can endure His burning anger? His wrath is poured out like fire; even rocks are shattered before Him.
passages.sermon:
God is powerful and holy.
No one can stand before His anger.
No one can endure His burning wrath.
God pours out His anger like fire.
Rocks break apart in His presence.
passages.original: לִפְנֵ֤י זַעְמוֹ֙ מִ֣י יַֽעֲמ֔וֹד וּמִ֥י יָק֖וּם בַּחֲר֣וֹן אַפּ֑וֹ חֲמָתוֹ֙ נִתְּכָ֣ה כָאֵ֔שׁ וְהַצֻּרִ֖ים נִתְּצ֥וּ מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃

passages.text: The LORD is good, a stronghold in the day of distress; He cares for those who trust in Him.
passages.sermon: The LORD is good.\r\nHe is a stronghold in the day of distress.\r\nHe cares for those who trust in Him.
passages.original: ט֣וֹב יְהוָ֔ה לְמָע֖וֹז בְּי֣וֹם צָרָ֑ה וְיֹדֵ֖עַ חֹ֥סֵי בֽוֹ׃

passages.text: But with an overwhelming flood He will make an end of Nineveh and pursue His enemies into darkness.
passages.sermon:
God is powerful.
God will judge Nineveh.
God will send an overwhelming flood.
God will destroy Nineveh completely.
God will chase His enemies.
God will drive His enemies into darkness.
passages.original: וּבְשֶׁ֣טֶף עֹבֵ֔ר כָּלָ֖ה יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה מְקוֹמָ֑הּ וְאֹיְבָ֖יו יְרַדֶּף־ חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃

passages.text: Whatever you plot against the LORD, He will bring to an end. Affliction will not rise up a second time.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is powerful.
The LORD ends every plan made against Him.
No one can succeed against the LORD.
He will stop all evil plans.
He will not allow trouble to come again a second time.
passages.original: מַה־ תְּחַשְּׁבוּן֙ אֶל־ יְהוָ֔ה כָּלָ֖ה ה֣וּא עֹשֶׂ֑ה לֹֽא־ תָק֥וּם פַּעֲמַ֖יִם צָרָֽה׃

passages.text: For they will be entangled as with thorns and consumed like the drink of a drunkard— like stubble that is fully dry.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about the enemies of Nineveh.
They will become trapped.
They will be tangled up like thorns.
They will be confused and helpless like drunk people.
God will destroy them completely.
They will burn up like dry stubble.
passages.original: כִּ֚י עַד־ סִירִ֣ים סְבֻכִ֔ים וּכְסָבְאָ֖ם סְבוּאִ֑ים אֻ֨כְּל֔וּ כְּקַ֥שׁ יָבֵ֖שׁ מָלֵֽא׃

passages.text: From you, O Nineveh, comes forth a plotter of evil against the LORD, a counselor of wickedness.
passages.sermon:
Nineveh is a city.
\r\nA person comes from Nineveh.
\r\nThis person plots evil against the LORD.
\r\nThis person gives wicked advice.
passages.original: מִמֵּ֣ךְ יָצָ֔א חֹשֵׁ֥ב עַל־ יְהוָ֖ה רָעָ֑ה יֹעֵ֖ץ בְּלִיָּֽעַל׃ס

passages.text: This is what the LORD says: “Though they are allied and numerous, yet they will be cut down and pass away. Though I have afflicted you, O Judah, I will afflict you no longer.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks with authority.
The LORD addresses Judah.
The LORD says, “Your enemies are united.
Your enemies are many.
I will cut them down.
They will pass away.
I have afflicted you, Judah.
I will not afflict you again.”
passages.original: כֹּ֣ה׀ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אִם־ שְׁלֵמִים֙ וְכֵ֣ן רַבִּ֔ים וְכֵ֥ן נָגֹ֖זּוּ וְעָבָ֑ר וְעִ֨נִּתִ֔ךְ לֹ֥א אֲעַנֵּ֖ךְ עֽוֹד׃

passages.text: For I will now break their yoke from your neck and tear away your shackles.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks to Judah.
The LORD promises freedom.
The LORD says, “I will break their yoke from your neck.
I will tear away your shackles.”
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה אֶשְׁבֹּ֥ר מֹטֵ֖הוּ מֵֽעָלָ֑יִךְ וּמוֹסְרֹתַ֖יִךְ אֲנַתֵּֽק׃

passages.text: The LORD has issued a command concerning you, O Nineveh: “There will be no descendants to carry on your name. I will cut off the carved image and cast idol from the house of your gods; I will prepare your grave, for you are contemptible.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks to Nineveh.
The LORD gives a command about you, Nineveh.
No one will continue your name.
You will have no descendants.
I will destroy the carved image from your temple.
I will remove the cast idol from your house of gods.
I will make your grave.
You are despised.
passages.original: וְצִוָּ֤ה עָלֶ֙יךָ֙ יְהוָ֔ה לֹֽא־ יִזָּרַ֥ע מִשִּׁמְךָ֖ ע֑וֹד מִבֵּ֨ית אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ אַכְרִ֨ית פֶּ֧סֶל וּמַסֵּכָ֛ה אָשִׂ֥ים קִבְרֶ֖ךָ כִּ֥י קַלּֽוֹתָ׃פ

passages.text: Look to the mountains— the feet of one who brings good news, who proclaims peace! Celebrate your feasts, O Judah; fulfill your vows. For the wicked will never again march through you; they will be utterly cut off.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Judah.
God promises deliverance from enemies.
Look at the mountains.
You see the feet of a messenger.
This messenger brings good news.
This messenger announces peace.
Judah, celebrate your feasts.
Judah, keep your vows.
No wicked person will pass through you again.
God will destroy all your enemies.
passages.original: הִנֵּ֨ה עַל־ הֶהָרִ֜ים רַגְלֵ֤י מְבַשֵּׂר֙ מַשְׁמִ֣יעַ שָׁל֔וֹם חָגִּ֧י יְהוּדָ֛ה חַגַּ֖יִךְ שַׁלְּמִ֣י נְדָרָ֑יִךְ כִּי֩ לֹ֨א יוֹסִ֥יף ע֛וֹד לַעֲבוֹר בָּ֥ךְ בְּלִיַּ֖עַל כֻּלֹּ֥ה נִכְרָֽת׃
